description: In today’s political landscape, it’s easy for one-party rule to dominate without real checks and balances. This is precisely the situation we’re facing in the New York State Assembly, where the current supermajority has led to a significant imbalance in our government. It’s more important than ever to break this supermajority and restore a fair, balanced approach that represents the true voice of the people—including the needs and concerns of our district.As a candidate for the New York State As
title: Breaking the Supermajority: Restoring Balance and Giving Our District a Voice
